title: Browse the managed home and create a project inside an existing home directory
prerequisites: Start a disposable local managed pi-web-ui with the patched server, provisioned /home/mapache alias and an existing home directory named ExistingProject.

steps.assert: A fresh client lists ExistingProject in Files.
Open project starts at /home/mapache and lists ExistingProject. Enter that directory.
Create a project named NewProject and verify the selected directory is /home/mapache/ExistingProject/NewProject after reloading.
